composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create a seated rabbit in charcoal stoneware with ears shaped like two flattened oval plates, one upright and one turned sideways. Its short body and broad feet keep the silhouette stable. Add a small mustard-glazed nose and shallow face marks with a questioning expression. Show fine mineral speckles and soft tool edges under cool side light on a pale sage background, avoiding plush or plastic appearance. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
